question: Can the court release my property?
answer_text: Yes. Under section 89 of the Code of Criminal Procedure the Court may restore attached property (or the net proceeds of a sale) to a person who, within two years of the attachment, appears before the Court, shows that he did not abscond or conceal himself to avoid execution of the warrant and was unable to attend the proclamation, and then the property shall be delivered to him after costs are satisfied.
